d:
In ' Yeh Paisa Bolta Hai ' you explore the powerful influence of money in all aspects of life. The track delves into how wealth speaks louder than words, shaping perceptions, decisions, and relationships. With sharp commentary and impactful bars, you emphasize the undeniable role money plays in society, highlighting its dominance over every facet of life.
